description: Animate a rigged 3D model. Either a ready-made move (free; characters: idle, walk, run, jump, attack, punch, kick, wave, hurt, death, cast, dance; four-legged animals: idle, walk, run, jump, attack, sit, hurt, death), a move copied from another of the user's rigged models (free: from_id + from_animation), or a description of any motion ('wag its tail', 'open the lid', 20 credits). Returns the clip, a GLB of the skeleton's motion that plays on the rigged model.

duration.description: Seconds, for a described motion (default: its natural length)

from_animation.description: The animation id on from_id to copy

from_id.description: Copy a move from this other rigged model (free)

prompt.description: Or describe the motion, e.g. 'a spinning kick' (20 credits)

name: animate_3d_model
